Time speed

1× = 1 simulated hour per second. Fast spin rates are capped for readability.

Date (UTC)

Planet positions use NASA/JPL approximate orbital elements (valid 1800–2050; typically arc-minutes, up to ≈10 arc-minutes for Jupiter and Saturn). Orbits are real ellipses. The Moon uses a standard mean-orbit series; moons of other planets start at arbitrary phases.

Display

About

Maps for the Sun, planets and Moon: Solar System Scope textures (CC BY 4.0), based on NASA data. Io, Europa, Ganymede, Callisto, Titan, Enceladus, Triton, the asteroids, comet and galaxy are procedural. Scientific figures are rounded. 3D engine: three.js (MIT). Realistic (1:1) scale is not offered: it is not usable interactively.
